newsitem.title: UK: Bluebird Toys share slides on AGM statement.
newsitem.headline: Bluebird Toys share slides on AGM statement.

text.p: Shares in Bluebird Toys Plc fell on Wednesday after the company's annual general meeting was told that trading conditions for world toy markets continue to be very difficult in the first few months of the year.
Shares in Bluebird Toys were down over 30 percent at 1008 GMT, off 50-1/2 pence at 119 pence.
The company said while the Polly Pocket and Disney brands were performing satisfactorily in most major markets, they were experiencing difficulties in North America.

Overseas shipments are expected to fall year-on-year as a result of "over-cautious inventory management in North America and a trade reluctance to support the Disney Tiny Collection to the levels we expected in that market".
"We therefore anticipate that our half-year results will be below the corresponding period for last year," the company said in a statement.

It added that while it was too early to comment with certainty on prospects for 1997 as a whole, the difficulties in North America would see full year profits "significantly below market expectations".
